title: Atmus Filtration Technologies Completes Acquisition of Koch Filter Corporation
summary: Atmus Filtration Technologies Inc. (“Atmus”; NYSE: ATMU), a global leader in filtration and media solutions, today announced that it has closed its acquisition of Koch Filter Corporation (“Koch Filter”) from Air Distribution Technologies, Inc. (“ADTi”), a portfolio company of Truelink Capital, for a total cash consideration of approximately $450 million, subject to customary purchase price adjustments. The completion of the Koch Filter acquisition establishes Atmus’ industrial air filtration platform and expands its portfolio into high-growth end-markets, including commercial and industrial HVAC, data centers and power generation markets. “We are excited to welcome the Koch Filter team to Atmus. Together, we are committed to unlocking our growth potential and executing our strategy of expanding into industrial filtration markets,” said Steph Disher, Chief Executive Officer of Atmus.
